description: Cadence at which evidence is produced or refreshed for a control.

terms.definition: Produced as a side-effect of the system's normal operation (e.g. streaming logs).
Refreshed at least once every 24 hours.
Refreshed at least once every 7 days.
Refreshed at least once each calendar month.
Refreshed at least once per calendar quarter.
Refreshed at least once per calendar year.
Produced when a triggering event occurs (e.g. incident, change, access request).
